messages:
sylvia: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need single-point owners for the recurring streaming issues (timeouts, silent partials, reconnect storms). Please claim ownership, add a single-line ETA, and note any small blockers. I'll fold into the retro packet.

omar: I'll own reconnect/backoff defaults + SDK samples. Plan: publish recommended settings (maxRetries=3, base=300ms, cap=5s, jitter 20%), add migration note for customers. ETA: Mon EOD. Ticket RW-9801.

keisha: I'll own partial-response detection and metric. Proposal: emit "partial_chunk_gap" event when inter-chunk gap > 6s without terminal error and add dashboard tile. ETA: Wed AM. Ticket RW-9802.

drew: I'll take server-side protections: soft circuit-breaker on write errors and a graceful KV-eviction window of 12s. Also add a deploy-time guard that samples chunk_gap.p90 during canary. ETA: Thu EOD. Ticket RW-9803.

infra-bot: Created ticket RW-9801 assigned to omar. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9801

infra-bot: Created ticket RW-9802 assigned to keisha. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9802

infra-bot: Created ticket RW-9803 assigned to drew. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9803

sylvia: Fast remediations for this week (flip in low-risk regions): 1) increase heartbeat frequency from 18s -> 10s for impacted fleets, 2) enable ephemeral replication for hot KV ranges, 3) add temporary routing fallback to sync endpoints for high-value customers. Who owns each?

omar: Devex will draft SDK samples for reconnect and add a short note recommending client heartbeat slightly shorter than server timeout. I'll ship the PR.

keisha: I'll validate telemetry impact of heartbeat bump, but we need an observability quota bump for the new metric. Can someone file that ticket?

drew: I'll own the replication toggle and routing fallback rollouts. ETA for toggle: Tue AM. I'll open RW-9804 for the toggle and rollout plan.

ops-bot: Ticket RW-9804 created by drew. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9804

keisha: Draft metric schema for RW-9802: ```json
{"event":"partial_chunk_gap","session_id":"string","gap_ms":"int","chunk_index":"int","node_id":"string","deployment":"string"}
``` Will refine in PR.

sylvia: Please add a 1-line impact estimate to each ticket (leadership asks for that). Example: "expected to reduce partial-stream alerts by ~30% in canary".

omar: RW-9801 one-liner: "SDK defaults smooth reconnects and reduce client-induced thundering; expected to lower reconnect storms by ~35% in canary."

keisha: RW-9802 one-liner: "detector surfaces silent partials for automated aborts and rollback triggers; expected +40% coverage on canaries."

drew: RW-9803 one-liner: "soft CB + eviction window to reduce tail inter-chunk gaps under memory pressure; expected to drop tail gaps by ~30% in tests."

sylvia: blockers? short please.

omar: No blockers. Need devex review for samples.

keisha: Blocker: observability quota bump needed to ingest partial_chunk_gap events. Can someone file RW-9805?

drew: I'll file RW-9805 and tag infra. ETA: today.

ops-bot: Ticket RW-9805 created by drew. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-9805

sylvia: Checklist for retro (owners, ETA, ticket):
- Reconnect/SDK defaults: omar  Mon EOD  RW-9801
- Partial-response detector + metric: keisha  Wed AM  RW-9802
- Soft circuit-breaker + eviction window: drew  Thu EOD  RW-9803
- Replication toggle (fast rem): drew  Tue AM  RW-9804
- Obs quota request: drew  Today  RW-9805

sylvia: React with :white_check_mark: if you accept or post a 1-line blocker. I'll capture progress and call out anything slipped at the retro.

omar: :white_check_mark: accepted. Will open PR for SDK samples by Mon.

keisha: :white_check_mark: accepted. Will need 30m pairing with infra to validate ingestion once quota is approved.

drew: :white_check_mark: accepted. Will schedule infra sync for replication toggle.

infra-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 3532109876 in 72 hours.

sylvia: Thanks — small updates only in-thread so I can keep the retro note live.
